frames.caption: 01 · CODE — Can the eye be explained?. A code is not a mood board. It is a set of recurring decisions—silhouette, proportion, material, finish, behavior, refusal—with examples, exceptions, and a reason for each. The test is not whether every object looks alike. It is whether a collaborator can recognize the governing judgment.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping can the eye be explained? within When Does a Designer Become a House?.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 02 · CARRY — Can another hand act without impersonating?. An institution needs roles, handoffs, review rituals, and vocabulary. Documentation should transmit the standard while leaving room for skilled interpretation. If every decision must return to the founder, the practice has staff but not institutional capacity.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping can another hand act without impersonating? within When Does a Designer Become a House?.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 03 · PROOF — Can the work prove its own making?. Collection records, samples, specifications, correspondence, credits, rights decisions, and accession-quality metadata turn memory into evidence. The record does not replace the object; it prevents the object from becoming anonymous.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping can the work prove its own making? within When Does a Designer Become a House?.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 04 · CONTINUITY — Can the system survive absence?. A house is tested by illness, departure, conflict, growth, sale, and succession. Continuity requires named authority, access to accounts and files, an archive, and a method for distinguishing evolution from imitation.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping can the system survive absence? within When Does a Designer Become a House?.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.caption: Codifying taste can become a cage. The goal is not to freeze a signature look; it is to preserve how decisions are made—including how the house recognizes when its old answer is no longer enough.
